plan.target_population: Adults receiving community-based support for chronic disease management during a 12-month program period.

conflict_items.constraint: The requested budget must not exceed the $70,000 maximum or the $75,000 available budget.
conflict_items.required_value: No more than $70,000 and no more than $75,000 available
conflict_items.explanation: The request exceeds both the applicable budget cap and the funding available.

conflict_items.constraint: Available staff capacity must support the planned coverage target.
conflict_items.plan_value: 310 people planned; available staff capacity is 260 people
conflict_items.explanation: The available workforce can serve 50 fewer people than the plan targets.

conflict_items.constraint: The plan must provide staff with every required qualification.
conflict_items.plan_value: Community Health Worker (CHW) certificate is planned; no Registered Nurse (RN) is planned or available
conflict_items.required_value: Registered Nurse (RN) and Community Health Worker (CHW) certificate
conflict_items.explanation: The required RN qualification is absent from both planned staffing and available staff.

conflict_items.constraint: Planned service areas must be eligible under the rules and reachable by available staff.
conflict_items.plan_value: North Quay is included in the plan; available staff serve Eastbank only
conflict_items.required_value: Eligible areas are Eastbank and South Ridge; available staff can serve Eastbank
conflict_items.explanation: North Quay is not an eligible service area and is outside the available staff's service area.

conflict_items.constraint: The plan must provide every required accessibility standard supported by available resources.
conflict_items.plan_value: Step-free service venue only; no on-site Arabic interpretation
conflict_items.required_value: Step-free service venue and on-site language interpretation in Arabic
conflict_items.explanation: The plan omits required Arabic interpretation, which is also absent from the available accessibility resources.

validation_summary: The plan fails budget, staffing capacity, qualification, geographic eligibility, and accessibility checks. Its coverage target meets the minimum, but available staff cannot serve the full target, the required RN qualification is missing, North Quay is ineligible and unreachable, and Arabic interpretation is not provided.
